definitions.explanation: The structural frame surrounding a window, including the sill and casing.

examples.japanese: {窓枠|まどわく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ペンキ→ペンキ：00342_penki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{剥|は}げている→剥げる：29715_hageru⟧。
examples.english: The paint on the window frame is peeling.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧{窓枠|まどわく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧もの⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{交換|こうかん}→交換：02746_koukan⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We replaced the old window frames with new ones.

examples.japanese: ⟦{猫|ねこ}→猫：02237_neko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{窓枠|まどわく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{座|すわ}って→座る：00757_suwaru⟧⟦{外|そと}→外：00671_soto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{眺|なが}めている→眺める：02132_nagameru⟧。
examples.english: The cat is sitting on the window frame, gazing outside.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧ (window) + ⟦{枠|わく}→枠：13100_waku⟧ (frame). The 〜⟦{枠|わく}→枠：13100_waku⟧ suffix appears in many compound nouns for frames and borders, such as ⟦ドア→ドア：00773_doa⟧⟦{枠|わく}→枠：13100_waku⟧ (door frame).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {窓枠|まどわく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{交換|こうかん}→交換：02746_koukan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to replace window frames
- {窓枠|まどわく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{座|すわ}る→座る：00757_suwaru⟧: to sit on the window sill
- ⟦{木製|もくせい}→木製：13083_mokusei_b⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{窓枠|まどわく}: wooden window frame
- ⟦アルミ→アルミ：08942_arumi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{窓枠|まどわく}: aluminum window frame

USAGE:
In everyday Japanese, {窓枠|まどわく} covers the entire frame structure including what English speakers might call the window sill, casing, or frame. Common in home renovation (⟦リフォーム→リフォーム：08821_rifoomu⟧) discussions and real estate descriptions.
